ui.privacy_note: Privacy Notice: Citizen contact information is strictly protected and accessible only to authorized administrators.
ui.help_how_body: You can describe your civic issue in natural language using English, Hindi, or Odia. The AI assistant categorizes your issue, determines urgency, allocates a tracking ticket, and directs it to the appropriate department.
ui.help_langs_body: Supported languages: English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Odia (ଓଡ଼ିଆ). Hinglish and colloquial phrases are also processed automatically.
ui.help_helpline_unset: Helpline information is managed by local municipal authorities (Demo prototype: no live toll-free line).
ui.help_tracking_body: Your Tracking ID (e.g. GRV-1001) is an official reference number issued when your grievance is registered. Use it anytime in the 'Track Complaint' tab to check progress, see timeline notes, or rate resolution.
ui.pin_notice_body: Save this 6-digit PIN securely. It is shown only once and is required to unlock full private complaint details and contact information.
ui.details_locked_hint: Sensitive details are locked for citizen privacy. Enter the tracking PIN issued during complaint registration to view them.
ui.wrong_credentials: The ticket ID or tracking PIN is not correct.
ui.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
ui.too_many_messages: Too many messages. Please wait a minute before sending another message.
ui.hero_desc: A unified multilingual municipal portal to file, track, and resolve civic complaints in your own words. No office visits or complex paperwork required.
ui.feature_multilingual_desc: File complaints in English, हिन्दी (Hindi), or ଓଡ଼ିଆ (Odia). Write naturally in local script or transliterated words.
ui.feature_ai_desc: Instant automated categorization and detail extraction, translating citizen reports accurately for swift officer review.
ui.feature_track_desc: Follow real-time milestone progress from submission through investigation to resolution using your tracking ID.
ui.feature_transparency_desc: Immutable timeline entries, clear status progressions, and departmental notes keep you informed at every step.
ui.feature_routing_desc: Complaints automatically route directly to the designated engineering, sanitation, electrical, or administrative teams.
ui.feature_urgency_desc: Safety hazards receive expedited attention, and nearby duplicate complaints automatically cluster for unified action.
ui.how_step1_desc: Speak or type your grievance in English, Hindi, or Odia without technical jargon.
ui.how_step2_desc: Automated triage classifies category, extracts location, and assigns the correct municipal department.
ui.how_step3_desc: Designated municipal officers inspect the issue on the ground and initiate corrective action.
ui.how_step4_desc: Receive live timeline updates and download an official acknowledgement receipt with your tracking ID.
ui.footer_motto: Towards a responsive and accountable India
ui.privacy_note_short: Public lookups hide your name and contact.
ui.citizen_login_note: No account needed. The mobile number is optional and only used to contact you regarding the complaint.
ui.invalid_mobile_msg: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6-9 (or leave blank).
